purpose: Newly added three-class sentence sentiment classification, separate from the original positive-emotion/toxicity workflow.
source_data: tyqiangz/multilingual-sentiments, used without its annotations for this model's zero-shot teacher distillation example.
limitations: Softmax outputs are uncalibrated model scores, not reliable confidence. Sarcasm, mixed sentiment, missing context, language, and domain changes can affect predictions. Model-card teacher/student agreement is not labeled accuracy and is not an evaluation result for this project. Post percentages count discrete predicted labels; they do not average model scores or measure all readers' opinions.
